stable_published_titular_contact_route.rule: A stable public production route for data-subject requests must exist. Preview, staging, localhost and placeholder routes are not evidence.

owner_and_backup_owner_assignment_artifa.rule: Named operational owner and backup-owner assignment must be independently reviewable.

identity_verification_procedure_artifact.rule: A reviewed identity-verification procedure must exist and must avoid disclosing data before verification.

tenant_scoped_access_export_test_receipt.rule: A controlled synthetic/non-customer receipt must prove tenant-scoped access/export behavior.

correction_workflow_test_receipt.rule: A controlled synthetic/non-customer receipt must prove the correction workflow.

deletion_anonymization_blocking_retentio.rule: A controlled synthetic/non-customer receipt must distinguish deletion, anonymization or blocking from legally required retention holds.

controller_operator_handoff_procedure_ar.rule: A reviewed procedure must define controller/operator handoff and ownership for requests.

reviewed_response_time_policy_artifact.rule: A reviewed response-time policy must exist; the collector cannot invent statutory or operational deadlines.

tabletop_request_receipt.rule: A tabletop request receipt must exercise intake, verification, routing, decision, response and evidence retention without real customer data.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: COLLECT_DIGEST_ONLY_RECEIPT
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Hash real reviewed procedures and controlled synthetic proof receipts; record only non-sensitive metadata.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: INDEPENDENTLY_REVIEW_RECEIPT_AND_SOURCE_ARTIFACTS
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Confirm route stability, ownership, identity verification, tenant scope, lifecycle semantics, handoff, response policy and tabletop proof.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: PROMOTE_DEDICATED_EVIDENCE_MIGRATION
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Only after real review, create a separate versioned migration updating exactly data_subject_request_channel with evidence_ref and evidence_digest.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: MERGE_GREEN_THEN_APPLY_ONCE
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Apply the exact merged evidence migration through Supabase.apply_migration only; execute_sql remains SELECT-only.
